  path={"/management/devices"}

>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindAll handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve device records with optional filtering and pagination.
It supports filtering by either "correlation_id", "fleet_id", or "imei" query parameters, but only one at a time.
If multiple filters are provided, it returns a 400 Bad Request error.
Pagination is controlled via "page" and "page_size" query parameters, with defaults and limits applied.
Returns a JSON response containing the paginated devices or an error message.
